timeline.body: Leading micro-frontend architecture in Angular and React. Integrating real-time analytics pipelines and designing cinematic interactive systems for corporate banking.
Building resilient services in Java Spring Boot with containerized deployment on Docker. Reengineering the main frontend to Next.js, improving Core Web Vitals metrics by 42%.
Creating immersive experiences for luxury and retail clients. End-to-end delivery from wireframes and Figma prototypes to frontend code with SVG and Canvas micro-animations.
Building interactive modules in modular JavaScript, laying out responsive interfaces and integrating REST APIs under agile methodologies.
